sum: Jyong Biotech Ltd., a science-driven biotechnology company, engages in the development and commercialization of plant-derived drugs for the treatment of urinary system diseases in the United States, the European Union, and Asia. It develops Botreso, for the treatment of benign prostate hyperplasia/lower urinary tract symptoms; PCP for treating prostate cancer; and interstitial cystitis (IC) for the treatment of IC/bladder pain syndrome. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
ceo: Ms. Fu-Feng  Kuo (CEO & Chairwoman of the Board)
